verses.text: Thank the LORD, because he is good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Let Israel say, "His faithful love lasts forever."
Let the family of Aaron say, "His faithful love lasts forever."
Let those who respect the LORD say, "His faithful love lasts forever."
When I was in trouble, I called to the LORD. The LORD answered me and set me free.
The LORD is with me, so I will not be afraid. What can mere people do to me?
The LORD is with me. He is my helper. I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
It is better to go to the LORD for safety than to trust in people.
It is better to go to the LORD for safety than to trust in rulers.
All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them down.
They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them down.
They swarmed around me like bees, but they burned out as quickly as burning thorns. In the name of the LORD I cut them down.
I was pushed hard and almost fell, but the LORD helped me.
The LORD is my strength and my song. He has saved me.
Shouts of joy and victory are heard in the tents of good people: "The LORD's right hand has done mighty things!
The LORD's right hand is lifted high! The LORD's right hand has done mighty things!"
I will not die. I will live and tell what the LORD has done.
The LORD has punished me hard, but he has not let me die.
Open the gates of goodness for me. I will go through them and thank the LORD.
This is the gate of the LORD. Good people will go through it.
I will thank you, because you answered me and saved me.
The stone the builders rejected has become the most important stone of all.
The LORD has done this, and it is amazing to us.
This is the day the LORD has made. Let's celebrate and be glad today!
LORD, please save us! LORD, please give us success!
Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the LORD! We bless you from the house of the LORD.
The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Tie the sacrifice with ropes to the horns of the altar.
You are my God, and I will thank you. You are my God, and I will honour you.
Thank the LORD, because he is good. His faithful love lasts forever.
